title: Motion for an extension of time to file the briefs on the merits

Michael E. Kenneally

1111 Pennsylvania Avenue, NW

July 17, 2025
VIA ELECTRONIC FILING
Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, D.C. 20543
Re: M & K Emp. Sols., LLC v. Trs. of the IAM Nat’l Pension Fund,
No. 23-1209
Dear Mr. Harris:
The Court granted the petition for a writ of certiorari in this case on June 30,
2025.  Under the Court’s rules, petitioners’ brief and the joint appendix are currently due on August 14, 2025, and respondents’ brief is due September 15, 2025.
Because of scheduling conflicts created by ongoing litigation matters and the
need for coordination among petitioners and their counsel, the parties request
14-day extensions of time to file petitioners’ brief and joint appendix and respondents’ brief.
In accordance with Rule 30.4 and subject to the Court’s approval, the parties
propose the following briefing schedule:
Petitioners’ brief and joint appendix: August 28, 2025
Respondents’ brief:    October 14, 2025
Respectfully submitted,

/s/ Michael E. Kenneally
MICHAEL E. KENNEALLY



cc: John E. Roberts, Counsel for Respondents
